reviewProvenance.manualVisualComparison: Current published figure stands symmetrically upright on a angular blue/gray cuboid base with large dark gray outspread feather wings and long vertical pale ribbons. Source displays a moving, bent-knee winged figure leaping above swirling gray cloud-vine effects, with pink circular rune rings and outstretched arms holding a spear-like golden implement. Pose, multilevel spiral base and wing/ribbon arrangement do not match. Source profiles and sculpt-detail views 2–7 corroborate. Same character/franchise is not the same 3D statue.
